common_mode.note: SPWM has zero common-mode by construction. The exact min-max zero sequence has a 3rd harmonic of 3*sqrt(3)/(8*pi)=20.67%, not 1/6=16.67%; the 1/6 rule is a different injection with the same line-line voltage and headroom but different common-mode/EMI.

hidden_pattern: The 15.47% is exactly 2/sqrt(3)-1 and lives in the linear limit, not in the line-line waveform: at equal modulation index both methods produce the same line-line voltage. SVPWM's zero-sequence is the price, and its third harmonic is the familiar 1/6 injection rule.
title: SVPWM = SPWM + min-max zero sequence; 15.47% is voltage headroom
